---
title: "Interactive HTML Modules"
---

Interactive HTML modules can be used for visual explanations of NLP mathematics.  Good candidates include tokenization, cosine similarity, smoothing, SVD, embedding geometry, attention matrices, positional encoding, sampling temperature, perplexity, and persistent homology.

## Design principles

- Each module should teach one mathematical concept clearly.
- Use Plotly.js or lightweight JavaScript visualizations when interactivity adds value.
- Keep formulas in standard LaTeX format using MathJax.
- Do not make the interactive component replace the explanation; it should support the explanation.
